programme_name: Master's degree in Molecular and Medical Biotechnology
admission_type_official_wording: Subject to entry requirements; procedure for assessing the required requirements

admission_routes.notes: Apply for the ESSE3 Eligibility Check, then enrol after a positive result.
Standard eligibility-check route, subject to legal-equivalence classification.
Apply through the 2026/27 international pre-admission call, followed by Universitaly and visa steps.

academic_requirements.summary: Either a degree in class 1/L-2, class 12/L-13, SNT/3/L-SNT3, or 46/S/LM-41, or another bachelor's/equivalent with at least 12 CFU in FIS/01-08 and/or MAT/01-08 and/or INF/01, 12 CFU in CHIM/01-08, and 36 CFU in BIO/01-19. Applicants below 85/110 receive additional curriculum assessment and possibly an interview. The international pre-admission route requires a foreign bachelor's in biological disciplines (including biotechnology, biochemistry, molecular biology, biology, microbiology or genetics), biophysics or bioinformatics, and CGPA at least 75/100.
academic_requirements.eligible_foreign_qualifications: Suitable equivalent; international-call formulation: bachelor's in relevant biological disciplines, biophysics or bioinformatics.

minimum_credits_by_subject_area.notes: Alternative route for applicants outside the listed degree classes.

academic_requirements.minimum_grade_or_gpa: Standard route: additional assessment below 85/110. International pre-admission route: CGPA or equivalent at least 75/100.
academic_requirements.curriculum_assessment: Curriculum, examinations, marks and exam syllabi are analysed, followed by a possible interview.

ranking_and_quota.ranking_details: Ordinary admission is not described as quota-based. International-call selection requires 60/100 overall, including at least 20 interview points.

selection_components.component: International-call CV and relevance of academic/extra-academic background

selection_components.weight_or_threshold: 0-50 points; pass requires 60/100 including at least 20 interview points
selection_components.notes: Interview only for candidates with CGPA at least 85/100 and at least 30/50 from the first two criteria.

language_requirements.summary: English at CEFR B2 is required.
accepted_language_certificates: Valid B2-equivalent certification listed by UNIVR CLA
Other full B2 certification/documentation accepted by the commission
certificate_exemptions: Degree certificate records a complete English B2 examination
For international pre-admission, previous degree taught in English
language_requirements.notes: Duolingo is accepted in the international call only for candidates from Iran or Afghanistan.

application_windows.applicant_category: Foreign-degree non-Italian applicants not resident in Italy

required_documents.document: Requirements Assessment Request Form and supporting academic records
Identity document or passport personal-data pages
Bachelor's diploma or enrolment certificate with expected graduation date
required_documents.condition: International-call candidates awaiting graduation must graduate by 30 June 2026.

required_documents.document: English transcript of records or Diploma Supplement
required_documents.condition: Include exams and preferably ECTS, weighted average and grading range.

required_documents.document: CV in English, maximum two pages

document_legalisation_translation_rules: Pre-admitted candidates must send the official translation and legalisation of the bachelor's diploma and a Declaration of Value from the competent Italian diplomatic office.

entry_exam_or_test.name: Personal-preparation interview
entry_exam_or_test.mode: Interview if needed; online under international-call selection
entry_exam_or_test.minimum_score: International call: 60/100 overall and at least 20/50 in the interview; interview access requires CGPA at least 85/100 and at least 30/50 from criteria 1-2.

application_fee.notes: International pre-admission contribution; credited against enrolment contributions except for scholarship winners.

tuition_amount_basis: First instalment EUR 358; second and third instalments vary under the university contribution and ISEEU/ISEE-equivalent rules.
